profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Calix
profile.summary: Embedded Software Developer with strong track record of delivering revenue-generating high availability products under challenging schedule constraints. Experienced in  Python, C, C++, Verilog, Bash. Skilled Hardware/Systems Architect.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Coded/architected L2/L3 hardware abstraction layer (HAL) for High Availability Access products.  Added various L2/L3 features. Architected/Implemented Python/Cython overlay to legacy C-based HAL. This work required deep knowledge of embedded Linux, Git, Yocto, L1/L2/L3, Broadcom SDK, and strong grasp of Git/Yocto/Coverity/Jira/Agile methdology.

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Developed Information-Centric Networking (ICN) Forwarder for Network simulator including FIB, Content Store and Pending-Interest Table (C++). Added ICN support to 100Gbps Network Processor of Large Carrier Router (NP4 Microcode). Co-developed ICN video demonstration running ICN on Cavium Octeon and Raspberry Pi (C,Bash). Originated Two Patented Inventions relating to Information-Centric Networking for Carrier Networks.

positions.title: Manager, Dataplane Engineering Group
positions.description: Led and contributed to small SW+HW team developing Carrier Ethernet/OTN features. Coded Applications and Test Automation in Python and C using Broadcom SDK. Delivered features under tight schedule and resource constraints. Worked feature requirements with PLM, guided implementation, reviewed code, developed buildbot test automation. mentored SW engineers. Feature PoC to Customer Support, Sales and Operations.

positions.title: Principal Systems Engineer/Architect
positions.description: Owned technical definition for forwarding plane related features. Performed architectural analysis, established functional requirements, and drove implementation with marketing, software, hardware, test and vendors.

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description: Architected, designed, and verified 25% of a FPGA-based GPON OLT.

positions.title: Team Lead, FPGA Design Group
positions.description: Delivered large hardware/software project, managed team of FPGA developers and designed/architected large FPGAs.

positions.title: ASIC/FPGA Group Lead
positions.description:
Led 10 ASIC/FPGA designers and managed next-generation avionics module development.
•	Delivered hi-rel rad-hard Firewire (IEEE-1394) chipset. 
•	Delivered 1 ASIC and 5 FPGAs successfully deployed on Cassini, DS1, Mars Rover spacecraft.

patents.title: System And Method For Routing Packets In A Stateless Content Centric Network
